traceTitle: auth/DoA/doa-importer-access.spec.ts:7 › Delegated Organisation - Notification Visibility › Carol Clark (agent for Plant Org 1) submits → Isabel Irwin (Plant Org 1 member) can see it
crossTypeNote: Cross-type evidence observed with a CHED-PP Plant-organisation fixture. CHED-P is a POAO application; this finding applies only the rendered delegated-authority mechanism and does not infer any POAO-specific journey detail.
journeySummary: Carol Clark submits a CHED-PP notification for IPAFFS Plant Organisation 1. A separate session for Isabel Irwin, a member of that client organisation, finds the submitted notification and has view, copy and amend controls.

observations.verbatim: View details; Copy as new; Amend
observations.accessibleName: View details / Copy as new / Amend
observations.meaning: The client-organisation member can open, copy and amend the submitted delegated notification.

visibilityOwnershipRules.rule: A submitted notification created by an authorised agent for a client organisation is visible to a member of that client organisation.
The client-organisation member receives view, copy-as-new and amend controls for the submitted delegated notification.

limitations: Despite the prompt's short description, this trace's rendered title and actions cover submitted client-member visibility, not contact/importer auto-population.
This trace creates CHED-PP with a Plant organisation and supplies no POAO-specific rendered detail.
Draft visibility is not tested in this trace.
